step1.title: Download from App Store
step1.description: Install the official WeChat app from the iOS App Store - ensure it's by Tencent.

step2.title: Register Account
step2.description: Launch WeChat, select 'Sign Up' and use your international mobile number. A friend with WeChat may need to verify you.

step3.title: Complete Verification
step3.description: Navigate to 'Me' → 'Services' → 'Wallet'. Follow the prompts to upload passport photos and complete facial recognition.

step4.title: Link Your Card
step4.description: After verification, go to 'Wallet' → 'Cards' → '+' to add your international credit or debit card.

step5.title: Configure Security
step5.description: Set up a payment password and enable Touch ID or Face ID for secure and fast transactions.

step1.title: Download from Google Play
step1.description: Install the official WeChat app from the Google Play Store - search for 'WeChat' and look for the app by Tencent.

step2.title: Create WeChat Account
step2.description: Open WeChat, tap 'Sign Up' and register using your international phone number. You might need a friend to verify you.

step3.title: Verify Your Identity
step3.description: Go to 'Me' → 'Services' → 'Wallet'. You will be prompted to complete identity verification. Upload photos of your passport.

step4.title: Add International Card
step4.description: Once verified, go to 'Me' → 'Services' → 'Wallet' → 'Cards' and tap 'Add a Card'. Link your international Visa/Mastercard.

step5.title: Set Payment Password
step5.description: Create a 6-digit payment password and enable fingerprint authentication for security.
